# visualize

The goal of visualize is to graph the pdf or pmf and highlight what area
or probability is present in user defined locations. Visualize is able
to provide lower tail, bounded, upper tail, and two tail calculations.
Supports strict and equal to inequalities. Also provided on the graph is
the mean and variance of the distribution.

## Installation

You can install the released version of visualize from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r

install.packages("visualize")
```

And the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("coatless/visualize")
```

## Examples

To use visualize, load the package with:

``` r

library("visualize")
```

Then, construct a graph by following the `visualize.dist()` pattern. For
example, the normal distribution can be shown with:

``` r

# Graph a standard normal distribution with a z-score of 1.96
visualize.norm(1.96)
```

![](reference/figures/README-visualize-normal-1.png)

``` r

# Change the location of the tail
visualize.norm(1.96, section = "upper")
```

![](reference/figures/README-visualize-normal-2.png)

``` r

# Create a bounded range.
visualize.norm(c(-1.96, 1.96), section = "bounded")
```

![](reference/figures/README-visualize-normal-3.png)

``` r

# Highlight both tails
visualize.norm(c(-1.96, 1.96), section = "tails")
```

![](reference/figures/README-visualize-normal-4.png)

The parameters of the distribution can also be modified. Take for
example the Binomial distribution.

``` r

visualize.binom(stat = 9, size = 20, p = 0.5)
```

![](reference/figures/README-visualize-binomial-1.png)

``` r

# Visualize the binominal distribution with a higher size and lower probability.
visualize.binom(stat = 9, size = 24, p = 0.25)
```

![](reference/figures/README-visualize-binomial-2.png)

Discrete distributions can also handle a level of strict (`<`, `>`) or
equal to (`<=`, `>=`) inequality.

``` r

# Create a strict inequality (lower < x < higher)
visualize.pois(stat = c(4, 6), lambda = 3.5, section = "bounded",
  strict = c(TRUE, TRUE))
```

![](reference/figures/README-discrete-inequalities-1.png)

``` r

# Allow for equality on either side only on the right side of the bounded region.
visualize.pois(stat = c(4, 6), lambda = 3.5, section = "bounded",
  strict = c(TRUE, FALSE))
```

![](reference/figures/README-discrete-inequalities-2.png)

``` r

# Allow for equality on either side of the inequality (lower <= x <= higher)
visualize.pois(stat = c(4, 6), lambda = 3.5, section = "bounded",
  strict = c(FALSE, FALSE))
```

![](reference/figures/README-discrete-inequalities-3.png)

## Citing the `visualize` package

To ensure future development of the package, please cite `visualize`
package if used during an analysis or simulation study. Citation
information for the package may be acquired by using in *R*:

``` r

citation("visualize")
```

# Package index

### Continuous Distributions

Visualize Distributions that are Continuous

- [`visualize.beta()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.beta.md)
  : Visualize Beta Distribution
- [`visualize.chisq()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.chisq.md)
  : Visualize Chi-squared Distribution
- [`visualize.exp()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.exp.md)
  : Visualize Exponential Distribution
- [`visualize.gamma()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.gamma.md)
  : Visualize Gamma Distribution
- [`visualize.norm()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.norm.md)
  : Visualize Normal Distribution
- [`visualize.unif()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.unif.md)
  : Visualize Uniform Distribution
- [`visualize.cauchy()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.cauchy.md)
  : Visualize Cauchy Distribution
- [`visualize.f()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.f.md)
  : Visualize F distribution
- [`visualize.lnorm()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.lnorm.md)
  : Visualize Log Normal Distribution
- [`visualize.t()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.t.md)
  : Visualize Student's t distribution
- [`visualize.wilcox()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.wilcox.md)
  : Visualize Cauchy Distribution
- [`visualize.logis()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.logis.md)
  : Visualize Logistic distribution
- [`visualize.continuous()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.continuous.md)
  : Graphing function for Continuous Distributions.

### Discrete Distributions

Visualize Distributions that are Discrete

- [`visualize.binom()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.binom.md)
  : Visualize Binomial Distribution
- [`visualize.geom()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.geom.md)
  : Visualize Geometric Distribution
- [`visualize.hyper()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.hyper.md)
  : Visualize Hypergeometric Distribution
- [`visualize.nbinom()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.nbinom.md)
  : Visualize Negative Binomial Distribution
- [`visualize.pois()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.pois.md)
  : Visualize Poisson Distribution
- [`visualize.discrete()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.discrete.md)
  : Graphing function for Discrete Distributions.

### Low-level graph functions

Underlying functions that power graphing for the package.

- [`visualize.continuous()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.continuous.md)
  : Graphing function for Continuous Distributions.
- [`visualize.discrete()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.discrete.md)
  : Graphing function for Discrete Distributions.
- [`visualize.it()`](http://r-pkg.thecoatlessprofessor.com/visualize/reference/visualize.it.md)
  : Visualize's Processing Function
